title: Perception pipeline (vision, OCR, barcode, depth)
purpose: Turn camera and sensor input into confidence-bearing observations (objects, text, barcodes, shelf structure, depth) behind stable ports, classical CV first.
architecturalScope: Perception bounded context. VisionPort plus specialized ports (OCR, BarcodeScanner, ShelfRecognizer, DepthEstimator, ObjectDetector). Adapters configurable local/remote.
domainContext: Observation, Confidence, BoundingBox, Shelf, ProductCandidate. Every observation carries confidence, source and timestamp.

milestones.title: Port contracts and dummy adapters
milestones.description: All perception ports defined; deterministic dummy adapters enable domain tests without hardware.

milestones.title: OCR and barcode on device
milestones.description: Tesseract and ZXing adapters run offline and are evaluated.

milestones.title: Shelf recognition baseline
milestones.description: Classical CV baseline recognizes shelf rows at acceptable confidence.

tasks.title: Define perception port interfaces
acceptanceCriteria: Domain tests run against dummy adapters without camera or network.

tasks.title: Benchmark on-device OCR candidates
tasks.description: Compare CER of Tesseract vs PaddleOCR on shelf-label and packaging datasets.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluation report with CER per candidate.

tasks.title: Implement barcode adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Barcode detection rate measured on a labelled dataset.

tasks.title: Shelf recognition baseline
tasks.description: Classical CV: detect horizontal shelf levels and candidate product rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Baseline metrics reported with confidence calibration.

tasks.title: Assess depth estimation only as non-metric
tasks.description: Determine whether monocular depth adds value without over-claiming distance.
acceptanceCriteria: Documented decision on enabling depth, defaulting to disabled.
Perception adapters are substitutable without changing domain code.
No adapter output is consumed without confidence.
Low-confidence observations produce an explicit uncertainty signal.

risks.description: OCR quality on curved, reflective packaging is poor.
risks.mitigation: Prefer barcode; use barcode/OCR cross-check; retry with guidance.

risks.description: Vision inference drains battery / overheats device.
risks.mitigation: Small models, duty cycling, reduced frame rate.

safetyImplications: Depth and detection outputs must never be used to claim a clear path; they are advisory only.
Stale observations must be discarded or flagged.
accessibilityImplications: Perception results must be expressible as spoken/haptic output; no vision-only dependency.
privacyImplications: Camera frames are processed ephemerally in memory and never persisted or uploaded by default.
Facial recognition is out of scope and must not be introduced.
verificationRequirements: Network isolation test proving local adapters make no calls.

decisionLog.decision: MVP perception is scoped to todo.live-camera-pipeline, todo.vision-product-search and todo.target-tracking; shelf recognition, depth and OCR/barcode move to this research track for later.
